data_description.office: The prefecture-level forecast office that publishes the forecast and warnings for your area.

data.area: Ward / municipality for warnings (市区町村)

data_description.area: The ward or municipality the warnings are read for, from the list of that forecast office.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description:
Warnings for {area}.

Observations: {primary}, with {secondary} for pressure and any missing values.

reconfigure.title: Pick the stations again
reconfigure.description:
Warnings stay for {area}.

The agency's tables now give: observations from {primary}, with {secondary} for pressure and any missing values.

Submit to use these stations and refresh the area names. A station id typed under Configure is replaced.

abort.already_configured: This area is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: A setup for this area is already in progress.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Japan Meteorological Agency's server.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The stations and names were updated.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This entry does not belong to the area it was made for. Add the area again instead.

data_description.station_primary: The nearest AMeDAS station that measures temperature; its readings come first.
data_description.station_secondary: The nearest type A station, used for pressure and for any value the primary station does not report.
data_description.volcano_radius_km: A volcano bulletin that names no municipality counts for the volcano sensor when the volcano is within this distance of Home Assistant's home. A bulletin that names municipalities counts when yours is one of them, whatever the distance. 0 turns the distance rule off.
data_description.debug_simulate: Lets the jma.simulate action fire test alerts at this entry; leave it off in normal use.

error.invalid_station: An AMeDAS station id is five digits, for example 44071.
error.unknown_station: No AMeDAS station has this id in the agency's table. Check the id, for example 44071.

simulate.name: Simulate alert (test only)
simulate.description: Fires an alert event as if JMA or P2P had produced it. Works for entries that have the debug option on.

event_type.name: Event type
event_type.description: One of the alert event types.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The JMA entry to fire the event at. Without it, every entry that has the debug option on gets it.

jma_unreachable.message: Could not reach the Japan Meteorological Agency's servers. Home Assistant will try again.

simulate_entry_not_found.message: No loaded JMA entry has that id.

simulate_not_enabled.message: That entry does not have the debug option on. Switch on "Enable the jma.simulate test action" in its options.

simulate_no_debug_entry.message: No JMA entry has the debug option on. Switch on "Enable the jma.simulate test action" in the options of an entry.

no_quake_socket.title: {title} has no earthquake connection
no_quake_socket.description: The earthquake service (P2P地震情報) allows {limit} connections per IP address, and other JMA entries use them. {title} shows no earthquake data until one of them is removed or disabled; it then takes the free connection by itself.

station_silent.title: AMeDAS station {station} is silent
station_silent.description: AMeDAS station {station} has sent no observation to {title} for a while, while its other station still answers. The station may have closed or changed its id. Open Configure on the entry and enter another station id, or run Reconfigure on the entry to pick the nearest stations again.
